START verify poincare-frechet-successor-codebook. Goal: (a) behaviour x geometry coupling, (b) trainability/switches, (c) integration. Read model/frechet_poincare.py, model/layers.py, model/model.py, train_rqvae.py. Observed so far: frechet path item_ids -> weight_of -> distances (poincare) + weighted commitment + FrechetCodebook.step; clamp_ball renormalises every point to radius 1-eps (not a true projection); frechet_codebook=USE_BEHAVIOUR and USE_GEOMETRY conflates two switches; Frechet step applied per-rank after optimizer.step with no all_reduce (DDP divergence risk). Still to verify: model/__init__.py, repo layout, result dir name, launcher contract, stage0 parquet columns, stage3 SID reader.

CHECK (a) behaviour x geometry coupling: PASS. One connected pathway: train_rqvae.py:318-322 builds the train-only successor table (indegree/(n+2), clip [0.25,4]) and binds it to every level's FrechetCodebook.item_weights; train_rqvae.py:412 passes item_ids into RQVAE.forward; model/model.py:29 -> model/layers.py:328 -> model/layers.py:140-149 curved branch (weights = frechet.weight_of(item_ids) at :146, geodesic cost frechet.distances at :147, argmin at :148, remember at :149); the same weights multiply the curved commitment at :166-168; model/model.py:40-62 -> frechet_poincare.py:121-154, where frechet_poincare.py:143-146 averages log_at tangents with member_weights and moves the slot by exp_at. Behaviour and curvature meet in the same expression (weighted tangent + exp map) and the moved slot decides the SID, so neither is a suffix. Exercised by source trace only (no torch/shell).

CHECK (b) trainability: NEEDS_FIX. Blocking finding 1: clamp_ball (frechet_poincare.py:35-38) always renormalises every point to radius (1-eps) instead of only projecting points that leave the ball. It is called by poincare_distance (:73-74), exp_at (:51), log_at (:56), log_0 (:65) and the Euclidean step branch (:150). Consequences: exp_at(0, 1e-3*e) returns a point of norm 0.999 (dist ~8.4 instead of 1e-3), so every Frechet step teleports the slot onto the boundary regardless of eta; poincare_distance([0.1,0],[0.9,0]) returns 0 instead of 2.2, so radial information is deleted from assignment/commitment; log_0(code) has norm up to ~8, so the decoder input and the residual chain (layers.py:164-165, layers.py:329) live on a different scale from the encoder latent; the commitment gradient carries 1/(1-r^2)*1/(1-d^2) factors and is then clipped to norm 1.0 at train_rqvae.py:419. Blocking finding 2: train_rqvae.py:246 sets frechet_codebook = USE_BEHAVIOUR and USE_GEOMETRY, so turning behaviour off also turns the curved path off (layers.py:303): the behaviour-off arm is identical to the both-off Euclidean arm, and FrechetCodebook.use_behaviour=False (frechet_poincare.py:107-108) is unreachable. The three required switches do not exist as three independent arms. Minor: self-transitions are not removed (train_rqvae.py:280-283 has no sources != targets although :259 and the spec say u != v); per-batch weight normalisation w/mean_batch(w) is missing (only the global /active.mean() at :286-288); unused buffer self.weights at frechet_poincare.py:98.

CHECK (c) integration: NEEDS_FIX. Blocking: the Frechet codebook step is applied on every DDP rank from rank-local state (train_rqvae.py:423 -> model/model.py:40-62 -> frechet_poincare.py:129-154). support/weight_sum are index_add_ over the local 1024-item batch (:131-134) and the weighted tangent sum is local; no dist.all_reduce and no broadcast of the moved codebook. DDP only syncs gradients, never parameters after init, so from the first optimizer step the four replicas hold four different codebooks, the mechanism's S_k is a 1/4 shard instead of the 4096 world batch, and rank 0's final checkpoint/SIDs are one of four divergent codebooks. Other integration points read OK: ARM_NAME/RESULT_DIR are inside results/stage2_RQ-VAE/ (train_rqvae.py:58-67), _repository_root walks to the stage2_RQ-VAE marker, SID export is item-id = embedding row (train_rqvae.py:512-527) with 4-digit collision extension (:208-221), SINGLE_GPU_ENV="GENREC_SINGLE_GPU" is read at :538 and returns to main() on one card, and the 4-card branch delegates to the frozen launcher (:554-564). Note: the tree's logs/ are stale baseline artifacts (they reference TIGER_bootstrap_consensus_sid and layers.py:102, which is not this file's line), so they are not evidence of a candidate run.

FINAL VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX (a=PASS, b=NEEDS_FIX, c=NEEDS_FIX). (a) one real pathway: train_rqvae.py:318-322 successor table -> :412 item_ids -> model/layers.py:140-149 weighted geodesic assignment/commitment -> :423 -> model/model.py:40-62 -> frechet_poincare.py:143-146 weighted tangent + exp_at step. PASS. (b) blocking 1: clamp_ball (frechet_poincare.py:35-38) projects every point to radius 1-eps instead of only clipping overflow, so exp_at teleports slots to the boundary (norm 0.999 for a 1e-3 step), poincare_distance([0.1,0],[0.9,0])=0, log_0(code) has norm ~8 and the residual/decoder scale breaks; commitment gradient factors 1/(1-r^2)*1/(1-d^2). blocking 2: train_rqvae.py:246 ANDs the two switches, so behaviour-off == both-off and FrechetCodebook.use_behaviour=False (frechet_poincare.py:107-108) is unreachable; the three required arms do not exist. minor: no sources!=targets self-transition mask (train_rqvae.py:280-283), no per-batch weight normalisation (:286-288), unused buffer frechet_poincare.py:98. (c) blocking: apply_frechet_codebook_step runs per rank on rank-local support/weight sums (frechet_poincare.py:131-146) with no all_reduce/broadcast, so the 4 DDP replicas' codebooks diverge after the first step and rank 0 exports one of four. Integration otherwise OK: frozen data paths, result dir results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, SID export item-id row indexed with 4th-digit collision extension, SINGLE_GPU_ENV=GENREC_SINGLE_GPU branch at :538, 4-card launcher delegated at :554-564. Tree logs/ are stale baseline artifacts, not a candidate run.

Behaviour = _build_successor_attraction (train_rqvae.py:253-289, train.parquet only, indeg/(n_v+2) clipped to [0.25,4]) -> frechet.set_weights (train_rqvae.py:319-322) -> FrechetCodebook.weight_of (frechet_poincare.py:105-109) -> (i) weighted commitment (layers.py:146,166-168) and (ii) weighted Frechet step (frechet_poincare.py:121-154) called from model.py:40-62 after optimizer.step (train_rqvae.py:420-423). Next: I am hand-evaluating the ball maps (no torch in this sandbox) before ruling on (b).

CHECK a (behaviour x geometry fidelity). Goal: find one live pathway where the training-only successor weight and a curved operation are used together. Read: tree files train_rqvae.py (whole), model/layers.py (whole), model/frechet_poincare.py (whole), model/model.py (whole), model/__init__.py, model/utils.py head. Observed: _build_successor_attraction (train_rqvae.py:256-300) builds w_v=(indeg+1)/(interactions+2), clips [0.25,4], normalises; bound into every FrechetCodebook buffer at train_rqvae.py:329-333 via set_weights (frechet_poincare.py:127-129). In training VQLayer.forward curved branch (layers.py:140-149) computes point=exp_0(latent), weights=frechet.weight_of(item_ids) (frechet_poincare.py:131-141), assignment argmin of poincare_distance (frechet_poincare.py:143-151), stores (point,index,weights) via remember. After optimizer.step the trainer calls raw_module.frechet_step_sums()/apply_frechet_codebook_step (train_rqvae.py:441-449 -> model.py:40-80 -> frechet_poincare.py:159-211), which forms weighted tangent sums log_{c_k}(z_i) and moves c_k <- exp_{c_k}(eta*m_k). Same weights enter the commitment layers.py:168-170 with poincare_distance^2 (frechet_poincare.py:153-157), giving encoder gradient. Removing behaviour (use_behaviour=False) returns all-ones weights; removing curvature switches distances/commitment/tangent to Euclidean (frechet_poincare.py:144-157, 180-183, 202-207). Conclusion: one connected path, no unused helper on it (utils.py is legacy and not imported). Still open: whether the path also executes under DDP and whether the gradient reaches intended params.

CHECK b (trainability). Goal: verify the coupled term is differentiable, reaches the encoder, and has no dead/unstable term. Read: layers.py:133-175 (forward + quant_loss), model.py:87-94 (compute_loss), train_rqvae.py:419-437 (train step). Observed: curved commitment is a function of point=exp_0(latent) with code detached, so d/d(latent) is live and non-zero; recon MSE gives the rest; x_q uses straight-through x+(x_q-x).detach() so nothing flows to the codebook, which is the proposal's stated estimator-not-gradient design; embed.weight is nn.Embedding (layers.py:68) still requires_grad=True though it never receives a gradient - relevant only to DDP (check c). Numerics: all atanh arguments clamped (1e-7), all ball points clamped to radius 1-1e-4, mobius denominators clamped min 1e-12, distances finite in float32/float64; exp_at cannot overflow since tanh saturates before division. Minor defect found: VQLayer.init_codebook (layers.py:180-187) runs KMeans in tangent space, maps centres into the ball with exp_0 (layers.py:81-86), then assigns with Euclidean _distances between tangent latents and ball centres and returns residual x - embed_code(ind) (ball coordinate), whereas training uses argmin of poincare_distance and residual x - log_0(code) (layers.py:145-167). So level 2/3 initial residuals are ~x - c/2 instead of x - c. Init-only, non-blocking. Still open: none for (b).

CHECK c (integration). Goal: entry point, frozen data path, SID export, result-dir isolation, launcher incl. single-card branch. Read: train_rqvae.py:40-120, 303-449, 509-595; logs in tree. Observed: EPOCHS=3000, batch 1024/rank x4, no early stop, final-epoch checkpoint; EMBEDDING_FILE=stage1_GeneEmbedding/output/sentence_t5.npy, TRAIN_FILE=results/stage0_build_parquet/train.parquet (frozen paths, consistent with the stale log all_items=24587/train_items=24556); exporter writes item_sids.json/sids_for_hgrec.npy/rqvae_best.pth/logs only under results/stage2_RQ-VAE/<ARM_NAME>, item-keyed 0..N-1, 4th collision level from cumsum offsets, with a uniqueness assertion; _launch_via_torchrun returns when SINGLE_GPU_ENV=="1" (line 564-568) and otherwise calls tools.research.stage2.launcher with port/world_size. Main defect: codebook parameters never receive a gradient (layers.py:166-174 detaches code and tangent; commitment uses code.detach()), yet they stay requires_grad=True and are not covered by find_unused_parameters=True at train_rqvae.py:344-345; the guard at 434-436 only clears a grad that never exists. DDP with find_unused_parameters=False and a requires_grad parameter that produces no gradient raises RuntimeError at the next forward ('Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration...'), i.e. at step 2 of epoch 1 in the frozen 4-card run; the single-GPU smoke cannot show it. Blocking. Correction: requires_grad_(False) on the frechet codebooks before DDP wrap (or find_unused_parameters=True). Minor: per-slot Python loops with per-slot device syncs (frechet_poincare.py:174-186, 198-210) make the claimed 3-6% step overhead unreachable. Still open: none.

VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX
(a) behaviour x geometry: PASS. Path: train_rqvae.py:256-300,329-333 -> layers.py:146-149 -> layers.py:168-170 + frechet_poincare.py:153-157 -> frechet_poincare.py:174-186 -> 198-204 -> model.py:75-80 -> train_rqvae.py:441-449. One connected path: successor weights bound per item, used in weighted tangent sums log_ck(zi), slot moved by exp_ck(eta*mk), same weights multiply the geodesic commitment giving encoder gradient. No runtime; traced the live trainer call chain. No finding.
(b) trainability: PASS (one minor). Commitment d(point, code.detach())^2 is differentiable in encoder through exp_0; tangent commit MSE live; codebook detached by design; atanh/Moebius/ball clamps prevent inf/nan. Minor: layers.py:180-187 init_codebook fits KMeans in tangent space, exp_0-maps centres (81-86), but assigns with Euclidean _distances and returns x - ball_code, while training assigns by poincare_distance and returns x - log_0(code); level-2/3 initial residuals are ~x-c/2, init only, does not gate.
(c) integration: NEEDS_FIX, blocking. train_rqvae.py:344-345 find_unused_parameters=False, codebook nn.Embedding requires_grad=True (layers.py:68) never gets grad because layers.py:168,170,174 detach and 148-149 argmin is discrete; 434-436 clears a grad that never exists. DDP with an unused requires_grad param raises RuntimeError at batch 2 of epoch 1 ("Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration..."), so the frozen 4-card run cannot train; single-GPU branch hides it. Repro: wrap any module with a requires_grad param detached before loss in DDP(find_unused_parameters=False), two iterations -> error. Fix: requires_grad_(False) on frechet codebooks before DDP (or find_unused_parameters=True). Minor: per-slot loops with syncs at frechet_poincare.py:174-186,198-210 (~1500 iterations, ~2e3 syncs/step) make the claimed 3-6% overhead unreachable; vectorise with index_add.
